questions.prompt: A musical quintet of 5 performers is chosen from 6 pianists and 5 singers.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Calculate the number of different quintets that contain at least 3 pianists.

questions.prompt: A project team of 4 people is chosen from 5 juniors and 7 seniors.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the number of different teams that contain at most 1 junior.

questions.prompt: Five balls are selected at random from a bag containing 8 distinct red balls and 5 distinct blue balls.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the number of different selections of 5 balls that contain at least 2 red balls.

questions.prompt: A rental agency has 6 distinct silver cars, 4 distinct black cars, and 3 distinct red cars available. Four cars are selected.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the number of different selections of 4 cars that include at least two different colours.

questions.prompt: A committee of 5 people is to be chosen from 7 men and 6 women.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Calculate the number of different committees containing strictly more men than women.

questions.prompt: A bag contains 9 distinct red marbles and 5 distinct blue marbles. Six marbles are selected from the bag.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the number of different selections of 6 marbles that contain at least 5 marbles of the same colour.

questions.prompt: A triathlon club has 6 swimmers, 8 cyclists, and 5 runners. A team of 7 athletes is to be selected, and it must contain exactly 1 swimmer.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the number of teams that contain exactly 1 swimmer and at least 5 cyclists.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the number of teams that contain exactly 1 swimmer, at least 4 cyclists, and at most 2 runners.

questions.prompt: An outdoor club has 5 archers, 6 bowlers, and 4 climbers. A team of 6 members is chosen such that at least one member from each activity is included.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the number of teams that contain exactly 3 archers and at least one member from each of the other two activities.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the number of teams that contain at least one member from each activity and strictly more bowlers than climbers.

questions.prompt: A chamber ensemble of 6 musicians is selected from 9 violinists, 5 cellists, and 3 bass players.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the number of different ensembles that contain at least 4 violinists and no bass players.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the number of different ensembles that contain at least 4 violinists, at least 1 cellist, and at most 1 bass player.

questions.prompt: Five letters are selected from the 9 letters of the word ELEMENTAL, which consists of three letters E, two letters L, and one each of M, N, T, and A.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the number of different selections of 5 letters that contain at least two letters E and no letter L.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the number of different selections of 5 letters that contain at least one letter E and at most one letter L.

questions.prompt: A board of 6 directors is chosen from 8 men and 6 women.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the number of boards that contain strictly more women than men.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the number of boards that contain at least 2 men and at least 2 women.

questions.prompt: A hospital emergency committee of 5 medical personnel is to be selected from 7 doctors and 5 nurses.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the total number of different committees of 5 personnel that can be formed with no restrictions.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the number of committees that contain at least one doctor and at least one nurse.

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: Find the number of committees that contain at least 2 doctors and at least 2 nurses.

questions.prompt: A box contains 7 distinct red counters, 5 distinct green counters, and 4 distinct yellow counters. Five counters are selected from the box.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the number of selections containing exactly 3 red counters.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the number of selections containing at least 4 counters of the same colour.

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: Find the number of selections containing at least one counter of each of the three colours.
